title: add-jsonschema-strict-response-validation-openai-compat
author: Maya Chen
description: Summary: Add first-class JSON Schema support to the response_format API surface with a strict validation mode and OpenAI-compatibility shims. Motivation: customers need reliable structured output for downstream parsing, and many integrations expect OpenAI-style schema semantics. This PR implements server-side schema validation, improved error messages with structured diagnostics, a strict=true enforcement flag that returns validation errors rather than best-effort corrections, and compatibility behaviors to match legacy OpenAI clients. Changes include API surface, runtime validation hooks, SDK examples, docs, and extensive tests. Checklist: - implement schema parsing and caching - add strict mode enforcement path - improve error messages with path/location and expected vs actual types - add compatibility behaviors controlled by response_format.openai_compat flag - update Python/TS SDK examples and docs - add unit/integration tests and e2e validation harness - perf tests to ensure validation latency is negligible Migration notes: existing clients without response_format set are unaffected. response_format schema parsing is opt-in; enabling strict mode may cause previously successful responses to fail validation if model output deviates from schema. Recommend staged rollout with feature flag and canary on Dedicated and Hosted tiers. Referenced work: ENG-3245, PR #621999 (previous schema helpers), PR #531246 (error messaging iteration).

Maya Chen: Buffering change applied to streaming pipeline; re-ran e2e tests and fixed two edge-case assertions.

merge_outcome: merged (squash) by Maya Chen after approvals; merge commit message: Add JSONSchema strict validation and OpenAI compat for response_format
release_notes: Add response_format JSON Schema support with a strict validation mode and improved error messages. Introduces response_format.openai_compat flag for legacy behavior. Strict mode may cause validation errors for previously accepted outputs; see docs/migration/response_format_strict.md for rollout guidance.
notes: Runtime validation is optional and guarded by feature flags for Hosted; Dedicated customers can opt-in per deployment. Metrics for validation failures are emitted to validation_failures_total and validation_latency_seconds. OpenAI-compat mode preserves previous error formatting for clients that depend on it.
security_notes: Schema parsing uses a sandboxed compiled representation with strict limits on recursion and size to avoid DoS. Validation budget enforced per-request.
qa_notes: Added unit, integration, and e2e tests. QA verified streaming buffering prevents premature validation; edge-case corpus exercised with synthetic malformed JSON outputs.
